source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"End the improvement process once the organization proves that a minimum external standard has been met for the current review period.","B":"Focus primarily on identifying the individual responsible after an adverse event instead of examining the processes that shaped performance.","C":"Limit quality-improvement work to external accreditation surveys rather than integrating measurement and testing into routine operations.","D":"Use an ongoing, data-driven process that measures performance, tests changes, learns from results, and repeatedly improves clinical systems."}}
source_row.rationale: AHRQ describes quality improvement as a systematic, data-driven process in which teams identify priorities, test changes, measure performance and continue learning and improvement over time.
